Name: Development
Definition and exclusions: Work to create a new physical or intangible asset, or the material amendment, upgrade or disposal of an existing one. This includes construction and infrastructure projects but also development of products and services.

Name: New development
Definition and exclusions: The construction, building or creation of a new physical asset or intangible work, from inception through to completion or delivery.
Topics: Building and construction, Real estate development, Infrastructure development, Product development, Software development, Fit-out (new), Facility creation, Prototyping

Name: Modification / expansion
Definition and exclusions: The material modification, expansion, refurbishment or upgrade of an existing physical or intangible asset, as distinct from routine maintenance.
Topics: Refurbishment, Fit-out, Expansion, Upgrade, Renovation, Redevelopment, System enhancement, Software release, Major maintenance (capex)

Name: Decommissioning
Definition and exclusions: The planned end-of-life decommissioning, dismantling or demolition of a physical or intangible asset, including associated regulatory aspects, environmental remediation, data migration and contractual wind-down. May be voluntary or compelled.
Topics: Demolition, Decommissioning, Asset retirement, Site remediation, Environmental clean-up obligations, Equipment disposal, Facility closure, Nuclear decommissioning

Name: Dispute resolution
Definition and exclusions: Work to resolve a dispute over legal rights, obligations, liabilities or remedies, whether by agreement or third-party decision. Does not cover responding to authority requests (e.g. warrants and subpoenas): these fall within Enablement.

Name: Consensual resolution
Definition and exclusions: A free-standing process in which parties reach an agreed resolution of a dispute through negotiation or facilitated dialogue, without any process already being underway to impose a binding decision by a court or third party. Only use at matter level if it is the substance of the matter as opposed to just a phase within it.
Topics: Settlement negotiation, Mediation, Conciliation, Early neutral evaluation (non-binding), Ombudsman scheme resolution

Name: Litigation
Definition and exclusions: Official proceedings in civil and commercial matters, taking place in a court established under public law, or in a statutory tribunal operating analogously to a court.
Topics: First instance civil proceedings, Commercial court proceedings, Appellate proceedings, Multi-party and group litigation, Class actions, Interim injunctions and applications, Challenge to arbitral awards

Name: Arbitration
Definition and exclusions: A private binding dispute resolution process in which parties confer authority on a neutral arbitral tribunal to determine the dispute, with the resulting award enforceable under arbitration law.
Topics: Emergency relief

Name: Determinative resolution
Definition and exclusions: A contractually or statutorily conferred process, other than litigation or arbitration, in which a neutral decision-maker has the power to impose a binding determination on the parties, whether finally or provisionally.
Topics: Expert determination, Disputes board, Valuation dispute resolution

Name: Enforcement
Definition and exclusions: Free-standing enforcement of a court judgment, arbitral award, settlement agreement or other binding determination, whether domestically or cross-border. Only use at matter level if it is the substance of the matter as opposed to just a phase within it.
Topics: Enforcement of court judgments, Enforcement of arbitral awards, Enforcement of settlement agreements, Enforcement of expert determinations, Cross-border recognition and enforcement

Name: Enablement
Definition and exclusions: Ongoing legal support to enables an individual, organisation or function to operate, advance their objectives and manage risk. Unlike other work type categories, Enablement is not defined by a particular process or transaction type: it covers ongoing advisory and functional support, and projects or initiatives that do not fall within a more specifically-defined work type category.

Name: Delivery
Definition and exclusions: Legal support for the operational delivery of an organisation's products and services to customers, including contractual, regulatory and customer-facing issues arising in the ordinary course.
Topics: Product and service delivery issues, Debt collection, Customer complaints handling, Consumer redress, Bid and tender support, Contract performance and management, Delivery-context regulatory compliance, Product recall coordination

Name: Revenue support
Definition and exclusions: Legal support for activities directed at generating revenue and managing the commercial terms on which an organisation's products or services are offered, including standard forms and pricing frameworks.
Topics: Standard terms and conditions, Pricing frameworks, Template customer agreements, Distribution and reseller arrangements, Sales and marketing legal compliance, Revenue-related regulatory compliance

Name: Internal resources
Definition and exclusions: Legal support for managing an organisation's internal physical, financial and intellectual property resources, excluding personnel matters (see Personnel).
Topics: Equipment acquisition and disposal, Office and facilities management, Treasury operations, Cash management, IP portfolio management, Internal insurance, Asset management, Real estate (internal)

Name: Personnel
Definition and exclusions: Legal support for employment and human resources matters arising in the ordinary course of operations, as distinct from strategic employment matters or contentious labour disputes.
Topics: Employment contracts and offer letters, HR policy development, Disciplinary and grievance procedures, Performance management, Right to work compliance, Benefits administration, Absence management, Workplace adjustments

Name: Entity management
Definition and exclusions: Ongoing legal management of corporate entities and their statutory obligations as part of business-as-usual operations, as distinct from M&A or substantive restructuring.
Topics: Corporate secretarial, Board and committee minutes, Statutory filings, Register maintenance, Director appointments and resignations, Annual general meetings, Powers of attorney, Group structure maintenance

Name: Third party relationships
Definition and exclusions: Legal support for the ongoing management of relationships with suppliers, outsourcing partners and other external third parties, as distinct from the initial negotiation of the relevant contract.
Topics: Supplier relationship management, Outsourcing oversight, Contract performance monitoring, Operational supplier disputes, Procurement compliance, Subcontractor management, Supply chain due diligence

Name: Organisational initiatives
Definition and exclusions: Legal support for the implementation of major internal programmes, including post-transaction integration, organisational change and business transformation initiatives. This does not include projects which can be categorised in other work types (e.g. use Development for product development programmes, use GRC & policy for horizon scanning and compliance programmes).
Topics: Post-merger integration, Operational restructuring implementation, Change management programmes, Digital transformation, Outsourcing implementation, Office relocation, Carve-out implementation

Name: Authority requests
Definition and exclusions: Responding to court orders, regulatory demands and official requests requiring an organisation to produce, preserve or surrender documents, data or assets.
Topics: Document production orders, Garnishment and attachment, Freezing order compliance, Evidential production requests, Warrant response, Subpoena and witness summons response, Regulatory information requests, Data preservation orders

Name: Representation (residual)
Definition and exclusions: Representing the interests of an individual or organisation in an official, administrative or public process that does not fall within a more specific work type.
Topics: Regulatory applications, Licence and permit applications, Planning and zoning applications, Public consultation responses, Administrative appeals, Ombudsman representations, Statutory notifications, Powers of attorney administration

Name: Advice (residual)
Definition and exclusions: Advice and assistance on specific legal questions that does not fall within a more specific work type. Also includes guidance and training.
Topics: Legal risk advice, Statutory interpretation, Ad hoc legal opinions, Due diligence advice, Training delivery, Legal guidance notes, Template and precedent advice, Civil liability advice, Criminal responsibility advice, Regulatory responsibility advice, Strategic advice

Name: Finance
Definition and exclusions: Work to structure, document and execute financial transactions, instruments and arrangements. Often used alongside another work type (such as Transaction or Development) but also arises independently, as in a refinancing or fund formation.

Name: Debt finance
Definition and exclusions: The structuring, documentation and execution of financing arrangements in which capital is provided by way of debt, including loans, bonds and hybrid instruments.
Topics: Syndicated loans, Bilateral loans, Leveraged finance, Mezzanine debt, High yield bonds, DCM (debt capital markets), Convertible notes, Bridge financing, Direct lending, Private credit, Repo and reverse repo, Structured finance, Term loan B

Name: Equity finance
Definition and exclusions: The structuring, documentation and execution of financing arrangements in which capital is provided by way of equity or equity-linked instruments.
Topics: IPO, Rights issue, Follow-on offering, ECM (equity capital markets), Private equity investment, Venture capital, Growth capital, PIPE transaction, Preferred equity, Buybacks, Stock splits

Name: Derivatives
Definition and exclusions: The structuring, documentation and execution of transactions involving financial instruments whose value derives from an underlying asset, rate, index or reference.
Topics: Interest rate swaps, Currency swaps and FX forwards, Credit default swaps, Equity derivatives, Commodity derivatives, Options, Futures, Total return swaps, ISDA master agreement documentation, Structured products

Name: Securitisation
Definition and exclusions: Transactions in which cash-flow generating assets are pooled and used to back securities issued to investors, including true sale and synthetic structures.
Topics: ABS (asset-backed securities), RMBS (residential mortgage-backed securities), CMBS (commercial mortgage-backed securities), CLO (collateralised loan obligations), CDO, True sale securitisation, Synthetic securitisation, Conduit structures, Covered bonds

Name: Project and asset finance
Definition and exclusions: Financing secured against or structured around the cash flows or value of a specific project or asset, typically on a non-recourse or limited-recourse basis.
Topics: Project finance (non-recourse), Asset finance, Infrastructure finance, PPP financing, Energy project finance, Aviation finance, Ship finance, Export credit financing, Islamic project finance

Name: Trade and receivables finance
Definition and exclusions: Short-term financing of trade transactions and the monetisation of receivables arising from them.
Topics: Letters of credit, Documentary credits, Receivables financing, Invoice discounting, Factoring, Supply chain finance, Forfaiting, Banker's acceptances, Trade guarantees

Name: Collective investments
Definition and exclusions: The establishment, structuring, documentation and ongoing operation of vehicles through which capital from multiple investors is pooled and managed.
Topics: Investment fund formation, PE fund, VC fund, Hedge fund, REIT, Infrastructure fund, Credit fund, GP/LP arrangements, Co-investment structures, Feeder funds, Fund documentation

Name: Loan portfolio sales
Definition and exclusions: The sale, purchase or transfer of portfolios of loans or other credit assets, whether performing or non-performing.
Topics: NPL (non-performing loan) portfolio sales, Performing loan portfolio sales, Loan-on-loan financing, Due diligence on loan portfolios, Regulatory capital transactions, Synthetic risk transfer

Name: GRC and policy
Definition and exclusions: Work to build, maintain and operate an organisation's governance structures, risk management frameworks and compliance programmes. Also includes influencing and responding to external legal and regulatory policy.

Name: Government affairs
Definition and exclusions: Work directed at influencing or responding to the development of legislation, regulation and public policy, including impact assessment, lobbying, advocacy and engagement with industry bodies and public authorities.
Topics: Regulatory consultation responses, Legislative impact assessment, Lobbying, Policy advocacy, Industry body engagement, Government relations, Pre-legislative submissions

Name: Regulatory affairs
Definition and exclusions: Securing and maintaining regulatory approvals and authorisations, responding to proposed regulatory changes or guidance, and providing ongoing regulatory advice within a specific regulatory regime.
Topics: Licence and authorisation applications, Regulatory approval processes, Regulatory change management, Ongoing regulatory advice, Regulatory horizon scanning, Regulatory relationship management, Product approval and clearance

Name: Risk and compliance
Definition and exclusions: Designing, implementing and monitoring an organisation's risk and compliance frameworks, controls and processes, including gap analysis, horizon scanning and compliance testing.
Topics: Compliance framework design, Control development, Gap analysis, Compliance monitoring and testing, Compliance audit, Risk assessment, Horizon scanning, AML/KYC programme design, Training programme design, Policy and procedure development

Name: Governance
Definition and exclusions: Designing, implementing and maintaining governance frameworks, board and committee structures, delegated authorities, codes of conduct and assurance mechanisms.
Topics: Board governance frameworks, Board and committee terms of reference, Codes of conduct, Delegation of authority frameworks, Assurance frameworks, Governance reviews, ESG governance structures, Whistleblowing frameworks, Reporting frameworks

Name: Investigative process
Definition and exclusions: Work to establish what has or has not occurred, through fact-finding, formal investigations, official inquiries or enforcement proceedings.

Name: Incident response
Definition and exclusions: The legal management of and response to a specific adverse event affecting an organisation's operations, data, assets, personnel or reputation, typically requiring urgent cross-functional coordination.
Topics: Cybersecurity and data breach response, Health and safety incident, Environmental incident, Product safety incident, Financial crime incident, Whistleblowing response, Reputational crisis management, Regulatory notification, Natural disaster or force majeure response

Name: Inquiry (official)
Definition and exclusions: A formal public process, typically conducted by or at the direction of an authority, to investigate matters of public concern and make findings of fact or recommendations, rather than to determine individual liability.
Topics: Official public inquiry, Non-statutory / independent inquiry, Truth and reconciliation commission, Planning inquiry

Name: Investigation (internal)
Definition and exclusions: A structured fact-finding process conducted within an organisation to investigate potential misconduct, regulatory breaches or other matters of concern, typically conducted so as to preserve legal professional privilege.
Topics: Internal fraud investigation, Misconduct investigation, Whistleblowing investigation, HR investigation, Data breach investigation, Anti-bribery and corruption investigation, Regulatory breach investigation, Dawn raid response (internal dimension)

Name: Investigation (official)
Definition and exclusions: A formal fact-finding process conducted by a state, regulatory or professional body to investigate potential wrongdoing by individuals or organisations.
Topics: Police investigation, Regulatory investigation, Competition authority investigation, Tax investigation, Professional regulatory investigation, Cross-border investigation, Dawn raid, Monitorship

Name: Prosecution or enforcement
Definition and exclusions: Criminal prosecution, disciplinary proceedings or civil enforcement action brought by a state, regulatory or professional authority against an individual or organisation alleged to have engaged in wrongdoing.
Topics: Criminal prosecution, Regulatory enforcement action, Civil penalty proceedings, Disciplinary proceedings, Confiscation and asset recovery, Extradition, Deferred prosecution agreement (DPA), Corporate criminal liability proceedings, Sentencing

Name: Dissolution and restructuring
Definition and exclusions: Work to wind up or restructure the affairs of an organisation or individual, solvent or insolvent, alive or dead. Includes formal liquidation processes and the administration of deceased estates.

Name: Reorganisation (solvent)
Definition and exclusions: A restructuring of an organisation's finances, contractual arrangements or corporate structure undertaken while the organisation remains solvent.
Topics: Corporate reorganisation, Debt refinancing, Capital structure optimisation, Covenant renegotiation, Consensual debt restructuring, Group simplification

Name: Turnaround / liquidation
Definition and exclusions: Formal insolvency, liquidation, bankruptcy and related processes for organisations or individuals in financial difficulty, including value-preservation strategies pursued in that context.
Topics: Formal insolvency proceedings, Liquidation, Bankruptcy, Receivership, Debt restructuring, Turnaround management, Provisional liquidation, Composition with creditors, Cross-border insolvency

Name: Deceased estates
Definition and exclusions: The administration and distribution of the estate of a deceased individual, including grant of probate or equivalent, estate accounts and distribution to beneficiaries.
Topics: Probate (and local equivalent), Letters of administration, Estate accounts, Distribution to beneficiaries, Contested estates, Inheritance and family provision claims, Foreign assets in estate

Name: Separation
Definition and exclusions: The legal dissolution or unwinding of a personal or business relationship, including the allocation of shared assets, rights and obligations as between the parties.
Topics: Divorce and dissolution, Financial settlement on separation, Business partnership dissolution, Joint venture termination, Shareholder exit arrangements, Relationship property division

Name: Transaction
Definition and exclusions: Work to bring about a change in legal status, ownership, rights or obligations, including the negotiation, documentation and execution of contracts and other legal arrangements giving effect to that change.

Name: M&A
Definition and exclusions: The purchase, sale, merger or combination of a business or a controlling or significant interest in it, including demergers and spin-outs.
Topics: Merger, Share acquisition, Asset acquisition, Demerger, Spin-out, Public takeover, Concentrative joint venture, Management buyout (MBO), Leveraged buyout (LBO), Carve-out

Name: Commercial contracts
Definition and exclusions: Negotiating and executing commercial contracts for the provision of services, supply of goods, licensing of technology or intellectual property, and other commercial arrangements between businesses.
Topics: Services agreements, Supply of goods contracts, Technology and software licensing, IP licensing, Outsourcing contracts, Cooperative joint ventures, Strategic alliances, Agency and distribution agreements, Framework agreements

Name: Non-commercial transaction
Definition and exclusions: Legal transactions that are not primarily commercial in nature, including those arising in a personal, family, charitable or employment context.
Topics: Family property settlement, Gift, Charitable donation or transfer, Trust settlement, Personal asset transfer, Employment-related transfer, Inheritance advance
